Woodleigh Mall Food Guide: 10 Must-Try Restaurants

Woodleigh Mall Food Guide 2026

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 6:45
Instaread

Right above Woodleigh MRT and anchored by Bidadari Park, The Woodleigh Mall is one of Singapore’s newest heartland malls, and its food scene has grown quickly since opening. From Korean BBQ to Xi’an-style Chinese burgers, there’s a genuinely broad spread of cuisines packed into its two above-ground levels and basement food hall.

This guide rounds up 10 places to eat at Woodleigh Mall, from French roast chicken to conveyor-belt sushi. Here’s where to start:

  • Bulgogi Syo – Korean BBQ grilled tableside
  • EAT. – authentic local Singaporean dishes
  • So Pho – Vietnamese pho and banh mi
  • Paradise Classic & LeNu – Chinese noodles and classic dishes from the Paradise Group
  • K.COOK Korean BBQ Buffet – all-you-can-eat Korean BBQ spread
  • Little Italy – classic Italian pastas and pizzas
  • Poulet – French-inspired roast chicken
  • Qin Ji Rougamo – Xi’an-style Chinese burgers (rou jia mo)
  • Tiong Bahru Bakery – artisanal pastries and European-style coffee
  • Genki Sushi – fresh conveyor-belt sushi

Let’s take a closer look at each spot….

Bulgogi Syo – Woodleigh Mall

Bulgogi Syo specialises in Korean BBQ, grilled tableside the traditional way, with marinated bulgogi beef as the signature draw alongside pork belly and other classic cuts. It’s the kind of place built for sharing a few plates over a long meal, with the usual spread of banchan side dishes rounding out the table. A solid pick if you’re after proper Korean grilling without heading into Seoul-themed districts further from home.

Unit: #01-33/34, The Woodleigh Mall, 11 Bidadari Park Drive, Singapore 367803
Phone: +65 9880 9729

Website: https://www.bulgogisyo.com

EAT. – Woodleigh Mall

EAT. focuses squarely on local Singaporean cuisine, the kind of home-style dishes that don’t always get a dedicated storefront in newer malls. Expect classics done properly rather than a sprawling menu trying to cover every cuisine at once. It’s a good stop if you’re craving something distinctly Singaporean rather than another international chain, and a nice contrast to the more Western-leaning options nearby.

Unit: #B1-K40, The Woodleigh Mall, 11 Bidadari Park Drive, Singapore 367803
Phone: +65 6875 0332

Website: https://eat.com.sg/

So Pho – Woodleigh Mall

So Pho brings a casual, approachable take on Vietnamese street food, pho noodle soups and banh mi sandwiches built for a quick, satisfying meal. The broth-based noodle bowls are the obvious draw, simmered with the aromatic spices that make a good pho worth seeking out. A dependable choice when you want something comforting without committing to a heavier meal.

Unit: #01-29/30, The Woodleigh Mall, 11 Bidadari Park Drive, Singapore 367803
Phone: +65 6320 0021

Website: http://www.sopho.com.sg/stores/

Paradise Classic & LeNu – Woodleigh Mall

From the same Paradise Group behind Beauty in The Pot and Canton Paradise, Paradise Classic & LeNu serves a menu built around Chinese noodles and classic regional dishes. Given the group’s track record across its other concepts, consistency and quality control are reliably strong here. A good all-rounder if you want proper Chinese comfort food without hunting down a specialist stall.

Unit: #01-41, The Woodleigh Mall, 11 Bidadari Park Drive, Singapore 367803
Phone: +65 6537 7646

Website: https://www.paradisegp.com/

K.COOK Korean BBQ Buffet – Woodleigh Mall

K.COOK takes the all-you-can-eat route to Korean BBQ, a wide spread of marinated meats, seafood and sides for diners who want to graze through multiple cuts rather than commit to a set menu. It’s a sociable format well suited to groups, with the buffet format meaning you can pace the meal however you like. A solid option if Bulgogi Syo’s a la carte format isn’t quite what you’re after.

Unit: #02-49/50, The Woodleigh Mall, 11 Bidadari Park Drive, Singapore 367803
Phone: +65 6322 3392

Website: https://www.facebook.com/kcooksg

Little Italy – Woodleigh Mall

Little Italy keeps things straightforward with a menu of classic pastas, pizzas and other Italian staples, the kind of reliable, crowd-pleasing cooking that works for a casual family dinner or a date night without the fuss of a more formal Italian restaurant. A dependable choice when the craving is specifically for Italian comfort food.

Unit: #02-48, The Woodleigh Mall, 11 Bidadari Park Drive, Singapore 367803
Phone: +65 9710 9052

Website: https://www.littleitaly.com.sg/

Poulet – Woodleigh Mall

Poulet built its name on one thing done consistently well: French-inspired roast chicken, slow-roasted until the skin crisps up while the meat stays juicy. It’s a simpler, more focused concept than a full French bistro, making it an easy, satisfying choice when you want something a step above typical fast food without the formality of fine dining.

Unit: #B1-26/27, The Woodleigh Mall, 11 Bidadari Park Drive, Singapore 367803
Phone: +65 6231 1594

Website: https://www.poulet.com.sg/

Qin Ji Rougamo – Woodleigh Mall

Qin Ji Rougamo specialises in rou jia mo, often described as China’s answer to the burger: shredded, slow-braised meat stuffed into a flaky, baked flatbread, a specialty of Xi’an in northern China. It’s a different take on Chinese street food than the usual noodle or rice options found elsewhere in the mall, and worth trying if you haven’t come across the dish before.

Unit: #B1-K35/K36, The Woodleigh Mall, 11 Bidadari Park Drive, Singapore 367803
Phone: +65 6592 4540

Website: https://m.facebook.com/people/QIN-JI-Rougamo/100089173008769/

Tiong Bahru Bakery – Woodleigh Mall

Tiong Bahru Bakery brings its celebrated artisanal breads and pastries to Woodleigh Mall, pairing them with a European-inspired coffee menu. The croissants and sourdough loaves are the stars here, though the prices do run a bit higher than your typical mall bakery, reflecting the quality of ingredients and technique on display. A good spot for a proper pastry rather than a quick, cheap bite.

Unit: #02-47, The Woodleigh Mall, 11 Bidadari Park Drive, Singapore 367803
Phone: +65 6877 4879

Website: https://www.tiongbahrubakery.com/

Genki Sushi – Woodleigh Mall

Genki Sushi runs on the classic conveyor-belt format, fresh sushi plates circling past your table so you can grab whatever catches your eye as it goes by. It’s an easy, interactive way to eat, especially for families or anyone who prefers picking a little of everything rather than committing to a fixed set menu. A reliable choice for a casual Japanese meal.

Unit: #01-31, The Woodleigh Mall, 11 Bidadari Park Drive, Singapore 367803
Phone: +65 6322 3392

Website: https://www.genkisushi.com.sg/

Wrap-Up: Eating Around Woodleigh Mall

From Korean BBQ to Xi’an-style Chinese burgers, The Woodleigh Mall has built a genuinely diverse food scene for a relatively new mall, right above Woodleigh MRT and next to Bidadari Park. Whether you’re after a sit-down meal or a quick basement food hall bite, there’s enough variety here for repeat visits.
